faq.q: What is the Crest Kayak in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is a small watercraft listed among Jason's Safehouse Vehicles in the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition. Rockstar's official screenshot archive contains a dedicated image titled Crest Kayak confirming its name.

faq.q: How do players get the Crest Kayak?
faq.a: It is included as one of Jason's Safehouse Vehicles with the Ultimate Edition. Rockstar has not described any other acquisition method.

faq.a: Rockstar's official material groups the Crest Kayak with other named vehicles under Jason's Safehouse Vehicles as an Ultimate Edition benefit. Rockstar has not explained further how safehouse vehicles function in gameplay.

faq.q: How fast is the Crest Kayak or how many people can it carry?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published a speed figure, passenger capacity or other gameplay specifications for the kayak. Such details should not be assumed from earlier Grand Theft Auto games, since Rockstar has not confirmed them for this entry.
